games.name: [🎃] Alkedion PVP
games.desc:
ALKEDION PVP

Welcome to Alkedion PVP, a fast-paced third-person shooter where every fight is all about skill, movement, and teamwork. Challenge players from around the world, create your own clan, and prove yourself on the battlefield.

🎮 Game Modes

• Free For All (FFA)
• 1v1 Duels
• 2v2 - 5v5 Team Battles & Clan Wars

✨ Features

• Smooth and responsive third-person combat
• Roll, sprint, crouch, and outplay your opponents
• Collect unique weapon skins and effects
• Create or join a clan and compete with others
• Climb the leaderboards and earn rewards
• Frequent events, giveaways, and new content

🏆 Progress

Win matches, unlock rewards, improve your skills, and become one of the strongest players in Alkedion.

🖥️ PC Controls

• WASD – Move
• Mouse – Aim
• Left Click – Shoot
• Right Click – Aim / Zoom
• Space – Roll / Dodge
• Shift – Sprint
• C – Crouch
• R – Reload
• V – Open Inventory

❤️ Enjoying the game? Like, Favorite, and Follow to support future updates.

games.name: [SUMMER] Randomizer: Redux
games.desc:
Game Version: Beta 2.5

This game is an official remake of the OG Randomizer, from the ground up!
It is still under HEAVY development, so everything is subject to change, and everything you see is incomplete! 

To use the admin panel in private servers, type '/admin' in chat.
For a list of commands, just type 'cmds' into the admin panel, premium users get extra commands!

Controls:
M - Menu (only when spawn protection is active, or you died)
C / CTRL / Button B / Circle - Crouch/Slide (while sprinting)
Shift / Left Stick - Sprint
P - Mouse Lock/Unlock
Left Alt - Camera Lock (Third Person)
